name: Childrens
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a precious heritage from the Lord, a divine reward entrusted to families (Psalms 127:3). The responsibility of raising children is serious and sacred, calling for intentional training and guidance in the ways of the Lord so that they remain faithful throughout life (Proverbs 22:6). Fathers, in particular, are instructed to nurture and admonish their children with care, avoiding provocation and fostering spiritual growth grounded in God’s truth (Ephesians 6:4). This underscores the vital role of Christian discipleship and ministry focused on children within the family and the church.
